title: 第13章 嗜血术
content_zh:
“小娃儿，你往后命数还长，不知道道爷的心里担忧。”

    “道爷今年九十多，凭着炼血功这假仙之法吞吃血食，已经苟活数年，再往后还能活多久，道爷自己也不知道！”

    “我活了这一辈子，怎么也不会甘心活到头来一场空！”

    石屋内，李老道对韩榆说着内心想法，最后端起碗中精血，咕嘟一口饮下。

    白发苍苍，口唇间满是渗人的鲜红。

    这模样虽然吓人，韩榆倒是并不害怕，只是说：“道爷，你可要小心，万春谷不允许私下修炼其他功法，更不允许修炼这种跟魔门有关的功法。”

    “一旦被发现，怕是有性命之危。”

    李老道听他这么说，嘶哑笑道：“你这孩子心地是好的，像你奶奶一样。”

    “不过，我要是不练炼血功，说不定死得更快，还是练吧。”

    又对韩榆说道：“你为了等我，拒绝了那个韦师姐的好处，说起来也是我耽误了你，作为补偿，我就把我身上最后的一点本事都交给你吧。”

    “我的武功，对修行者来说不值一提，也没什么借鉴的必要，毕竟凡人打凡人的技击之法，说来说去也不过就是寻常。”

    “炼血功还有一个法术，名为嗜血术，可以通过嗜血的方式来短暂提升自己实力，只是要事先预备足够精血，或者事后紧急补充。这法术和血滴子一样，只能紧急时候用来保命，不到万不得已，千万不要用。一旦当着万春谷等修仙正宗门派用出，必然是要被人家追杀。”

    “现在我就把这嗜血术传授给你。”

    韩榆讶然：“道爷，你还藏了一个法术？”

    李老道嗤笑：“之前谁知道你是什么品性？我没把你翻脸拍死还传给你功法，就已经是看在你奶奶的面子上！”

    韩榆无言以对，他从记事开始就没有见过奶奶，倒是没想到因为奶奶被李老道这样另眼相看。

    学了嗜血术运用之法后，韩榆便回到自己石屋。
content_en:
"Little baby, you still have a long life in the future. I don't know how worried Dao Master is."

"Master Dao is over ninety this year. He has been surviving for several years by relying on the fake immortal method of blood refining and eating blood. Master Dao himself doesn't know how much longer he can live!"

"I have lived this whole life, and I will never be willing to live in vain!"

In the stone house, Li Laodao talked to Han Yu about his inner thoughts, and finally picked up the blood essence in the bowl and drank it in one gulp.

His hair is gray, and his lips are full of oozing bright red.

Although this appearance was scary, Han Yu was not afraid. He just said: "Master Tao, you have to be careful. Wanchun Valley does not allow private practice of other techniques, let alone such techniques related to the Demon Sect."

"Once discovered, my life may be in danger."

When Li Laodao heard what he said, he laughed hoarsely and said, "You kid has a good heart, just like your grandma."

"However, if I don't practice blood refining, I might die faster, so I might as well practice it."

Then he said to Han Yu: "In order to wait for me, you refused the benefits of Senior Sister Wei. Speaking of which, I delayed you. As compensation, I will give you the last bit of my ability."

"My martial arts is not worth mentioning to practitioners, and there is no need to learn from it. After all, the martial arts method of mortals fighting mortals is just ordinary."

"The Blood Refining Technique also has a spell called Bloodthirsty. You can temporarily increase your strength through bloodthirsty. You just need to prepare enough blood essence in advance, or replenish it urgently afterwards. This spell is the same as the Blood Drop. It can only be used to save your life in emergencies. Do not use it unless it is absolutely necessary. Once it is used in front of Wanchun Valley and other orthodox sects of immortal cultivation, they will definitely be hunted down."

"Now I will teach you this bloodthirsty technique."

Han Yu was surprised: "Master Dao, do you have another magic hidden?"

Li Laodao sneered: "Who knew what your character was before? I didn't beat you to death and teach you the skills, just for the sake of your grandma!"

Han Yu was speechless. He had never seen his grandma since he could remember, but he didn't expect that Li Laodao would regard his grandma in such a special light.

After learning how to use the bloodthirsty technique, Han Yu returned to his stone house.
